item.title: Firefighters from Woonsocket rescue Chowchow trapped on thin ice
item.description: On February 13, members from the Woonsocket Police Department and the Woonsocket Fire Department rescued a missing Chowchow named Zara after she became trapped on thin ice. Zara had been spotted on the iced over pond behind Kennedy Manor on Clinton Street.
